techniques.name: 四宫格轮流运动，其余冻结
techniques.intent: 用一个运动窗口引导视线，其他画面保留静止上下文。

operations: scale/crop each clip to its tile; preserve aspect
for tile i freeze entry frame before active window
play selected source range during active window
freeze exit frame after active window

parameters.values: all timings are tutorial examples, adjustable
parameters.source_anchors: not recoverable numerically from tutorial; select verified source seconds

timing.frame_boundary: end hold uses last included source frame, not source_out exclusive boundary

outputs: four-tile composite with exactly one moving tile at a time then common hold

pitfalls: 仅叠四段视频并不产生轮流冻结，必须有每层的静态/动态/静态时间映射。
多轨首尾必须统一到18秒；源秒与教程源秒不同。
边界帧要按源帧时间锁定，避免多停一帧或从错误源位置启动。
validation: 检查每个窗口之前/开始/结束/之后的连续帧，确认仅当前格运动且冻结帧一致。
检查四格接缝、比例、无遮挡、整体尾段全部静止。

techniques.name: 统一多画面色调与尾段风格变化
techniques.intent: 减轻四段不同色彩的杂乱感，并区分共同定格尾段。

operations: apply shared grade to composite group
transition between pre/post look via explicit envelope or lossless group cache
align texture interval with frozen tail
trim music on verified phrase and fade

parameters.look: exact named filter/effect assets required; generic grayscale/sepia is approximation

timing.look_change: example around12s; any overlap must account for group/audio duration

outputs: group-consistent look change and aligned music

pitfalls: 原生特效资源未提供，不能用泛化滤镜冒称同款。
教程二次有损导出不应变成代码默认；保留可编辑组或无损缓存。
对组做转场可能改变时长，要重新验节奏和音乐尾部。
validation: 检查色调过渡及特效作用范围，确保四格同受处理。
实际听审音乐后才确认曲风/音质；此处未试听。

unknowns: 四段源入点、比例缩放准确数字、预设资源ID未知。
ASR在第三格拉长处出现8/18秒歧义；连续结构与多轨详图支持共同18秒结尾，卡中标记为示例目标而非逐帧实测。
